## Brief
The same widening lands on every other file BAD-036 splits, so a guard added once covers actions.ts and the account page too.

Evidence: Verified today: grep -rn "'../accounts'|'@/lib/accounts'" admin/src/lib/accounts/ prints nothing, and the only importers of the module are app/accounts/page.tsx, app/accounts/[email]/page.tsx, components/AccountControls.tsx and lib/activity.ts, all through the barrel.
